actions.script: const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.ComposeServices.get#ComposeData').parameters({emailMessageId: emailMessageId || null, replyToEmailMessageId: replyToEmailMessageId || null, forwardEmailMessageId: forwardEmailMessageId || null, replyAll: String(replyAll) === 'true', replyToCommEventId: replyToCommEventId || null, replyToSender: String(replyToSender) === 'true', contactListId: contactListId || null, to: to || null, cc: cc || null, bcc: bcc || null, subject: subject || null, body: body || null, recordEntity: recordEntity || null, recordId: recordId || null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {compose: out.compose})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.ComposeServices.save#ComposeDraft').parameters({emailMessageId: emailMessageId || null, fromValue: fromValue || '', toJson: toJson || '[]', ccJson: ccJson || '[]', bccJson: bccJson || '[]', subject: subject ?? '', body: body ?? '', bodyText: bodyText || null, quoteHtml: quoteHtml || null, parentEmailMessageId: parentEmailMessageId || null, isForward: String(isForward) === 'true'}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {emailMessageId: out.emailMessageId, rootEmailMessageId: out.rootEmailMessageId})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.ComposeServices.send#Compose').parameters({fromValue: fromValue || '', emailMessageId: emailMessageId || null, toJson: toJson || '[]', ccJson: ccJson || '[]', bccJson: bccJson || '[]', subject: subject ?? '', body: body ?? '', bodyText: bodyText || null, quoteHtml: quoteHtml || null, parentEmailMessageId: parentEmailMessageId || null, isForward: String(isForward) === 'true', parentCommEventId: parentCommEventId || null, replyToSenderOnly: String(replyToSenderOnly) === 'true', uploadsJson: uploadsJson || null, recordEntity: recordEntity || null, recordId: recordId || null, scheduledSendDate: scheduledSendDate ? new Date(Number(scheduledSendDate)) : null, holdSeconds: holdSeconds != null && holdSeconds !== '' ? Number(holdSeconds) : null, archiveThread: String(archiveThread) === 'true', threadStore: threadStore || null, threadId: threadId || null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {mode: out.mode, emailMessageId: out.emailMessageId, statusId: out.statusId, sent: out.sent, sendError: out.sendError, scheduledSendDate: out.scheduledSendDate, communicationEventIdList: out.communicationEventIdList, message: out.message})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.EmailClientServices.send#DueDrafts').parameter('emailMessageId', emailMessageId || '').call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {sentCount: out.sentCount, failedCount: out.failedCount})
